status: NON-CONVERGED CHECKPOINT — run stopped at growth iter 6 of 60 for spend discipline; NOT a completed run
why_stopped: The pre-registered command was executed verbatim. MPS sampling alone took 9548.7s (~2.65h). Each QSCI growth iteration is CPU-bound and its cost grows steeply with subspace size (iter deltas: 11s, 515s, 760s, 981s, 1329s, 1678s). Extrapolating, reaching the requested iter 60 would take >30h. The script writes its evidence JSON only after iter 60, which is computationally unreachable on this instance, so this checkpoint was constructed by hand from the live log + /proc + nvidia-smi. Stopped per the 6-hour checkpoint rule and because the verdict is already determined and unpushable (see note on read-only token).

NOTE: the script's built-in peak metric is HOST RSS (7.87 GB), which would have mislabeled this PASS; reported transparently and scored against the pre-registration's stated device-memory terms.

honesty_statement: All three pre-registered predictions for the 40q headline run (P1, P2, P3) FAIL as executed. This is reported with the same prominence as a success, per the pre-registration. No threshold was moved. The failures are internally consistent: P2's own extrapolation (~1.13e6 determinants for chemical accuracy) is ~20x larger than the determinant budget the pre-registered command's growth schedule can reach (~6e4), so the energy plateaus ~13 mHa above the DMRG(chi=400) reference (P1 fail), while the tensornet-mps sampling workspace exceeded the 8 GB device budget (P3 fail).
